name: Greater Mage Slayer (Combat)
body:
Your disdain for magic grows and your ability to harm those who use magic expands.

Prerequisite(s): Mage Slayer, Improved Critical, base attack bonus +10.

Benefit: Your critical threat range against creatures with spellcasting features or spell-like abilities increases by 1. This improvement is applied after the effects of the Improved Critical feat. For example a character with Improved Critical (greatsword) and this feat would have a threat range of 17-20/x2. Against an enemy wizard their threat range would increase to 16-20/x2.
